Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer repeatedly ran the same search and returned SERP snippets without opening authoritative sources or extracting/citing the explicit size figure, despite the Planner’s clear instruction to open and verify from official or reputable pages. This led to a loop with no conclusive answer, even though the needed value (728,000 sq ft) was readily available and could have been confirmed and cited from sources like Wikipedia or the mall’s materials.
